rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality blastocyst with strong ICM and cohesive TE consistent with 4AA, and appropriately notes limits of static-image assessment; minor inconsistency in calling it early-to-full rather than clearly hatching as reported.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, FSH, uterine factor, smoking, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis adjusted for uterine factor and smoking; only minor tension between image-based stage comments and reported Gardner stage.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice: single embryo transfer for a good Day-5 blastocyst, uterine cavity optimization, smoking/alcohol cessation, luteal support, and caution against unsupported add-ons.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including uterine evaluation, lifestyle modification, SET, and when to consider further testing.
